`settlement-vectors.json` is copied unchanged from `server/settlement-vectors.json` (generated from the server's settlement tests, `server/src/engine/settlement.ts`). Do not hand-edit it; re-copy it from the server when the server's vectors change.

From the repository root, refresh the fixture with:

```sh
cp server/settlement-vectors.json contract/tests/fixtures/settlement-vectors.json
```
